subject: Post-call: Synera MAP draft & timeline
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@synerahealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP (attached)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call:

- Goal: replace batch report pipeline with near-real-time scoring using Redwood inference to improve clinician alerts latency.
- Key constraints: PHI handling in-region, SOC 2 evidence, 3-month POC with anonymized data, procurement timeline tied to security review.
- Proposed target close: end of June (subject to security review).

Attached is an initial draft of a Mutual Action Plan I pulled together during the call (SY-Map-v0.2.xlsx). Highlights:
- Milestone 1 (POC kickoff): Redwood to deliver PoC env + sample integration spec — owner: Redwood (Rachel) — target: 2026-05-24
- Milestone 2 (Security review): Synera security review & evidence request — owner: Synera (Alex) — target: 2026-06-07
- Milestone 3 (Pilot validation): 2-week pilot with success metrics — owner: Synera/Clinical team — target: 2026-06-21
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence link, data access approvals, test VPC whitelisting

Ask: Please confirm owners and whether the target close (end of June) still looks feasible on your side. If you prefer a different cadence, we can push dates and plan weekly checkpoints.

Attachments: SY-Map-v0.2.xlsx (draft MAP)

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Rachel.Kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

--
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@synerahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@synerahealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP (attached)

Rachel —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft — very helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Ownership: I'll own the clinical validation milestone and loop in Dr. Patel as needed. Procurement (cc'd) will handle contract and legal.
2) Security: our InfoSec team needs SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short architecture diagram showing PHI isolation. Can you point me to a SOC 2 package or a Drive link?
3) Timeline: end of June might be tight given our internal review cycles. Can we set a conservative target close to July 15, with the POC still starting in late May?
4) Dependencies: we need a list of required sample schemas and an estimate of token/throughput cost for the pilot.

I'm attaching our RFP snippet that lists procurement desiderata.

--
Alex Moreno
Director of Clinical Integrations | Synera Health
alex.moreno@synerahealth.com
(617) 555-0921

Attachments: Synera_RFP_Reqs.pdf

Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Response from Synera + proposed MAP updates

Team —

Alex pushed the close to ~July 15 and requested SOC 2 artifacts plus an architecture diagram. Procurement is engaged. Suggested internal approach below before I reply to Alex:

- Update MAP to v0.3 with shifted dates (POC kickoff 2026-05-24 remains, Security review target 2026-06-21, Pilot validation window 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-18, target close 2026-07-15).
- Action owners: Rachel (POC delivery, integration spec), Ben (security artifacts & SOC 2 pointer), Sean (engineering for VPC setup & test data onboarding).
- Deliverables to attach in reply: SY-Map-v0.3.xlsx, Redwood SOC2-summarized.zip (pointer), architecture-diagram.png (pointer).
- Cost note: include an initial estimate for token volumes and a note that we can optimize with caching & quantization recommendations during POC.

Next steps for Rachel: send updated MAP + ask for a preferred weekly checkpoint cadence (30 min recurring). I can draft the security artifact bundle and Sean can produce the VPC checklist by EOD Friday.

Thanks —
Ben

Alex —

Per your note, please find the updated Mutual Action Plan attached (SY-Map-v0.3.xlsx). High level changes:

- New target close: 2026-07-15
- Security review target moved to 2026-06-21 (owner: Synera)
- Pilot validation scheduled 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-18 (owners: Synera clinical + Redwood)
- Added dependencies: list of sample schemas required from Synera, SOC 2 evidence link, approved IP/contract clause for PHI handling

Overdue / open items (please confirm):

- Sample schemas: can you share a sample of the EHR extract (CSV/JSON) by Wed 05/20?
- Procurement: confirm POC SOW acceptance and procurement point of contact (if different from procurement@synerahealth.com)

Proposed cadence: 30-min weekly checkpoint (Wednesdays, 10:00am ET) starting 2026-05-27. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: SY-Map-v0.3.xlsx

Link references: HubSpot deal (https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/SY-2026-0510) and our shared MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSY-Map-Synera)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
